message.content:
Since \(a \equiv 62 \pmod{99}\) and \(b \equiv 75 \pmod{99}\), we have

\[
a-b \equiv 62-75 \equiv -13 \equiv 86 \pmod{99}.
\]

So we need \(n\) in \(\{1000,1001,\ldots,1098\}\) such that

\[
n \equiv 86 \pmod{99}.
\]

Now,

\[
1000 \div 99 = 10 \text{ remainder } 10,
\]

so numbers in the range congruent to \(86 \pmod{99}\) are

\[
99 \cdot 10 + 86 = 990 + 86 = 1076.
\]

Thus the required integer is \(1076\).

The answer is 1076.
